commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' What an opportunity! Aleix Garcia (Girona) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post!
90+2' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent. Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) will miss the next game.
90+1' Pablo Torre (Girona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Pablo Torre (Girona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
87' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

86' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
83' Michel decides to make a substitution. Savio will be replaced by Valery (Girona).
83' Artem Dovbyk goes off the pitch and Cristhian Stuani (Girona) comes on.

67' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Aleix Garcia (Girona) after he collected a pass and unleashed his low drive. The ball was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
65' Michel has decided to make a change. Arnau Martinez (Girona) replaces David Lopez.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yangel Herrera departs the field of play to be replaced by Portu (Girona).

63' Yangel Herrera (Girona) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the left post, but is stopped by a great save from Jan Oblak and the score remains the same.

62' Aleix Garcia (Girona) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.

57' Substitution. Jhon Elmer Solis Romero makes way for Pablo Torre (Girona).
56' A big opportunity missed by Artem Dovbyk (Girona). He got on the ball inside the box and thumped a splendid first-time shot on goal, but it went narrowly wide of the left post.

24' The foul by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) was seen by Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

13' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
12' Eric Garcia (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
